entries.speaker: Confidants
entries.en: [clr 2]Confidants[clr 27] are people you trust who share a[n]similar goal. You can find these people in[n]places like school or around town.

entries.speaker: Confidants
entries.en: Try forming bonds with people by visiting them[n]multiple times, earning their trust, and proving[n]your value.

entries.speaker: Confidants
entries.en: Once you have formed a bond, you can open the[n]menu with [f 1 10 25] and select [clr 2]Confidant[clr 27] to check the[n]strength of your relationships.
